# SLA Group Resources

> Free, private resources for sex addiction and porn addiction recovery, for partners healing after infidelity or betrayal, and for couples rebuilding trust. Guides, support groups, books, podcasts, accountability apps, worksheets, and encrypted trackers. Independent and volunteer-run: not affiliated with, endorsed by, or paid by BetterHelp, any therapist, or any support group. Many resources were first shared by people in the Sex Addiction group sessions on BetterHelp. Nobody pays to be listed. Not medical advice. Contact: slagroupresources@gmail.com

## Guides
- [Sex addiction recovery: where to start](https://www.slagroupresources.com/sex-addiction-recovery.html): signs of compulsive sexual behavior, first five steps, free 12-step groups, a 90-day detox, handling urges, disclosure to a partner.
- [Healing after infidelity and betrayal](https://www.slagroupresources.com/healing-after-infidelity.html): for partners hurt by cheating, hidden porn use, or sex addiction. Betrayal trauma, self-care, boundaries, disclosure, support groups (S-Anon, COSA).
- [Rebuilding trust after infidelity](https://www.slagroupresources.com/rebuilding-trust.html): for couples. Honesty versus transparency, what helps from each partner, no fixed timeline, a weekly check-in, Recovering Couples Anonymous.
- [Need help right now?](https://www.slagroupresources.com/help-now.html): a breathing guide and urge timer, steps for riding out an urge, and steps for the first hours after finding out.

## Main page
- [Sex addiction and infidelity recovery resources](https://www.slagroupresources.com/): the full list, each item tagged for people in recovery, couples, or partners who were hurt.

## Trackers (private, encrypted in the browser with the user's own passphrase; no email or account)
- [Feelings check-in](https://www.slagroupresources.com/feelings-check-in.html): a turnable feelings wheel and log.
- [90-day tracker](https://www.slagroupresources.com/90-day-tracker.html): daily check-ins with 30, 60, and 90 day milestones.
- [Coping skills log](https://www.slagroupresources.com/coping-skills-log.html): triggers, feelings before and after, and which coping skills help most.
Reports can be shared with a therapist as a PDF or an expiring, encrypted link.

## Sections
- [Find support](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#support): Sex Addicts Anonymous (SAA), Sex and Love Addicts Anonymous (SLAA), S-Anon, COSA, Recovering Couples Anonymous (RCA), and the Sex Addiction group sessions on BetterHelp (BetterHelp membership required).
- [Recovery practices](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#practices): bringing the session home (the person in recovery takes notes in their group and shares them with their partner), rebuilding trust, handling urges, everyday mood basics.
- [Books](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#books): Patrick Carnes (Out of the Shadows, Facing the Shadow), Out of the Doghouse, Help Her Heal, The Porn Trap, Dopamine Nation, and more.
- [Podcasts](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#podcasts): Porn, Betrayal, Sex and the Experts (PBSE), Unhooked, and others.
- [Apps](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#apps): Covenant Eyes, Ever Accountable, Canopy, Truple, Brick, and others.
- [Handouts](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#files): Healthy Sexual Decision Framework, Feelings Wheel, Coping Skills Log, 90-Day Detox Summary.
- [Common questions](https://www.slagroupresources.com/#faq): what sex addiction and betrayal trauma are, whether relationships survive infidelity, the 90-day detox, disclosure, what to do when an urge hits, where to find a group.

## Crisis
In the U.S., call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline) or call 911 in an emergency.
